mentions.name: Graaf
mentions.description: A header-only C++20 graph library designed to be easy and intuitive to use while remaining performant and generic enough to be useful. Version 1.2.0 has been tagged, and it is available in Compiler Explorer so it can be tried without installing anything.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Graaf — a header-only C++20 graph library.

Started it mainly to experiment with C++ design patterns. Honestly never expected anyone to actually use it, but somehow it picked up some traction along the way :)

Graaf is designed to be easy and intuitive to use while being performant and generic enough to be useful.
